definitions.explanation: A celebrated, unforgettable scene in a film, drama, sports match, or other performance that audiences remember and replay.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{名場面|めいばめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This movie has many famous scenes.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{名場面|めいばめん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{語|かた}り{継|つ}がれている→語り継ぐ：22312_kataritsugu⟧。
examples.english: The comeback in that match is passed down as a memorable scene.

examples.japanese: ⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名場面|めいばめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧⟦{特集|とくしゅう}→特集：13468_tokushuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{放送|ほうそう}→放送：02093_housou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: At the end of the program, a special collecting the drama's famous scenes was broadcast.

notes:
Compound of {名|めい} (famous, excellent) + ⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧ (scene). The prefix {名|めい} marks something as outstanding, as in ⟦{名|めい}{作|さく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧ (masterpiece) or ⟦{名|めい}{言|げん}→名言：20185_meigen⟧ (famous saying).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名場面|めいばめん}{集|しゅう}: collection of famous scenes
- ⟦{数々|かずかず}→数々：12722_kazukazu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名場面|めいばめん}: numerous memorable scenes
- {名場面|めいばめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る→振り返る：04231_furikaeru⟧: to look back on the highlights

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見|み}せ{場|ば}→見せ場：14112_miseba⟧: highlight; showpiece moment — the part meant to impress, from the performer's side
- ハイライト: highlights — borrowed word, often for sports or recap footage
